_comment: Recorded state of two English writing standards: no em dashes, and prose
that contracts like a person. Both regressed once already. These numbers
are a ceiling, not a target: build/audit_site.py fails on anything worse
and warns when a file improves so the number here can be lowered. Never
raise a value to make a build pass.
em_dashes: per-file count tolerated today. 45 of validation-status.md's
are one repeated table cell; the other 2 sitewide are prose and should go.
stiff_pages: contractions per 1000 prose words on pages measurably below the site median. Empty, and the goal is to keep it that way.
